"""Second emitted clone group: a different structural shape, twice."""


def twin_beta_first(text: str) -> list[str]:
    rows: list[str] = []
    upper = 0
    lower = 0
    for line in text.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        if stripped.isupper():
            upper = upper + 1
        else:
            lower = lower + 1
        rows.append(stripped)
    rows.append(str(upper))
    rows.append(str(lower))
    return rows


def twin_beta_second(text: str) -> list[str]:
    rows: list[str] = []
    upper = 0
    lower = 0
    for line in text.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        if stripped.isupper():
            upper = upper + 1
        else:
            lower = lower + 1
        rows.append(stripped)
    rows.append(str(upper))
    rows.append(str(lower))
    return rows
